allowed: absolute numerical verification of each named control only after an independent reference is frozen
an artifact-derived pre-implementation refusal when a reference cannot be made independent
a terminal diagnostic pass, fail, or refusal for each control layer
forbidden: a physical-validation or target-facing laboratory claim
a scientific habit row or C1-C5 execution
a solver, state, checkpoint, or permanent surface-operator contract change
choosing reference values, tolerances, grids, or fixtures after production output is inspected

freezeOrder: this S1 foundation and its obligation classes
one S5 layer supplement containing either the complete independent-reference protocol or the artifact-derived pre-implementation refusal
the S5 reference bytes and one targeted independent reference check, when the independent-reference branch is taken
production comparison implementation in a later commit whose ancestry includes the applicable S5 freeze
packet preflight, frozen control execution, artifact-derived evaluation, and publication

exact reference and implementation source hashes
exact launch commands and expected runtime envelope

physical domain, fixed geometry, field and flux reference values
norm weights, expected order, and lower bound
residual, divergence, smoother-drift, and iteration limits

the tied orbit and tie/margin rule
expected event time, topology, post-event field, and ledger

reference derivation with exact raw output bytes
one targeted independent calculation or semantic check
production witness from only the frozen roster
artifact-derived refusal committed before production implementation
the exact unavailable operand, shared-arithmetic seam, missing state, or unjustified expectation
the attempted derivation route and why it is not independent
a receipt marking later producer/run obligations not applicable because of this refusal
forbidden: an absent file treated as a refusal
a producer or solver run after the refusal

obligationClasses.requirement: freezes every S5-reserved field for one layer before reference or production output
exactly one complete conditional branch is published
an implementation separate from the reference derivation checks every load-bearing reference quantity
raw fields and operands are emitted only when the independent-reference branch is complete
the evaluator ignores producer verdicts and recomputes the disposition from protocol, reference, and witness bytes
every named mutation executes, moves an independent witness, preserves the clean capture, and fails its attacked check
the matrix route is callable, the exact roster and ancestry are valid, and runtime, paths, disk, and stale-writer checks pass before execution
every claim-bearing byte and terminal disposition is digest-pinned

independenceRules.scientificArithmetic: reference derivation, production comparison, and artifact evaluator may share the frozen mathematical specification but do not share scientific-arithmetic implementation or mutable implementation code
permittedSharedCode: strict artifact schema and binary decoding that supplies neither side of a scientific comparison
independentReferenceForbiddenImports: LKSolver or its private aggregate boundary and smoother arithmetic
a producer report or producer verdict as expected truth
independentEvaluatorForbiddenImports: the corresponding reference implementation's scientific arithmetic
production boundary, topology, event, norm, or ledger arithmetic
historical report verdict fields as authority
independenceRules.quantitativeOperandRule: an operand also used by production is frozen in the S5 supplement and receives the targeted independent check; importing the same production function on both sides is not independent
independenceRules.topologyRule: a moving-event reference freezes explicit integer-coordinate topology or an independently enumerated neighbor table rather than importing production topology decisions
independenceRules.dependencyAudit: a static import/dependency check is a required preflight witness for every reference and evaluator route
independenceRules.testHooks: testAlphaOverride, testExtraSeedSites, testMode, and any equivalent test-only surface/state substitution are forbidden from all evidence routes

rawArtifactRules.producerVerdict: non-authoritative and ignored by the independent evaluator
requiredBindings: freeze and implementation commits with ancestry result
exact runtime, head, command, process concurrency, start, finish, exit status, and attempt identity
raw binary or canonical JSON witness byte length and SHA-256
rawArtifactRules.malformedOrMissingBytes: artifact refusal, never scientific fail or pass
rawArtifactRules.scientificFail: a well-formed independently referenced comparison misses its frozen criterion
rawArtifactRules.resourceRefusal: a registered cap prevents completion; no roster reduction or numerical-failure label is allowed

referenceRequirements: constant-coefficient spherical Robin problem with a finite Dirichlet shell
independently derived surface supersaturation and complete radial field
requested and actual radial spacing plus node count
normRequirements: relative surface-supersaturation error at every roster member
growth-velocity comparison at every roster member
productionWitness: all frozen input operands and actual derived spacing
surface value, shell value, growth velocity, and node count

negativeControls.expected: the production raw witness hash moves and the independent numerical-accuracy evaluation fails; this mutation does not establish or attack reference independence

negativeControls.mutation: remove or alter only the production-side finite-shell contribution
negativeControls.expected: raw witness hash moves and the independent evaluator fails

negativeControls.mutation: change only a producer-reported radial error or summary verdict without changing raw reference or witness bytes
negativeControls.expected: the independent evaluator ignores the forged summary or reports disagreement

refusalTriggers: the exact field or growth velocity cannot be derived without importing production spherical arithmetic
a load-bearing quantitative operand cannot receive an independent check
the required raw field cannot be emitted without a forbidden contract change

requiredOperatorCoverage: nontrivial fixed three-dimensional field and boundary flux
residual, divergence, and directly metered smoother-drift diagnostics

physical domain, fixed geometry, active mask, boundary sampling set, flux definition, units, and weights
analytically justified expected order and lower bound
complete raw reference field and boundary-flux bytes at every frozen level
normRequirements: the S5-defined weighted L2 boundary-flux norm
observed-order calculation over the exact roster
residual, divergence, and independently recomputed smoother-drift bounds
productionWitness: exact grid, domain, policy, far-field, geometry, and coefficient echoes
complete float64 field and active/attached masks
boundary indices, neighbor counts, opposing and boundary field values, attachment coefficient alphaHK, and flux operands
monopole shell targets and raw shell diagnostics
relaxation report and raw divergence/smoother-drift operands

negativeControls.mutation: change one production-side aggregate boundary-stencil operand or ordering without moving the frozen reference
negativeControls.expected: raw field or flux witness hash moves and the independent norm/order evaluator fails

negativeControls.mutation: introduce the production aggregate boundary or smoother implementation into the static reference route
remove one frozen grid level from an otherwise complete static roster
negativeControls.expected: the roster check refuses and no observed-order PASS is possible

negativeControls.mutation: change only producer-reported norms or observed order without changing raw reference or witness fields
negativeControls.expected: the independent evaluator ignores the forged values or reports disagreement

explicit tied attaching orbit and a frozen tie/margin rule
independent event time, topology transition, post-event relaxation field, and exact kinetic ledger
explicit integer-coordinate topology or independently enumerated neighbor table
checkRequirements: exact attached-cell orbit and D6h closure
placed fill plus unapplied clipping equals computed kinetic demand

commonNegativeControls.mutation: make exactly one otherwise well-formed layer fail or refuse

negativeControlExecutionRule: each control executes its named mutation, an independent witness proves the mutation moved, the clean capture remains unchanged, and the attacked check fails

terminalSemantics.pass: the independent-reference branch is complete and every frozen criterion and negative control passes
terminalSemantics.fail: well-formed independently referenced output misses at least one frozen numerical or control criterion
terminalSemantics.refusal: a named reference-independence, artifact, infrastructure, or resource condition prevents a valid comparison and is published from bytes
terminalSemantics.aggregatePass: all three layers take the independent-reference branch and have status pass
terminalSemantics.aggregateNonPass: any layer fail or refusal prevents PASS
terminalSemantics.packageCompletion: a layer failure or refusal may complete the selected Phase 10 package when fully reported; it blocks dependent future qualification and never becomes PASS

commandSeparation.preflight: read-only obligation, callable-route, ancestry, runtime, roster, path, disk, and stale-writer checks
commandSeparation.referenceOrRefusal: S5-only command/module that emits either frozen reference bytes plus derivation metadata or the explicit pre-implementation refusal
commandSeparation.targetedReferenceCheck: separate command/module that does not import the reference scientific arithmetic
commandSeparation.producer: S6 command/module that runs only the frozen roster and emits raw witness bytes without the independent verdict
commandSeparation.independentEvaluator: separate command/module that re-derives norms, events, ledgers, and disposition from protocol/reference/witness bytes
commandSeparation.aggregate: combines the three terminal layer artifacts using all-layers-pass semantics
commandSeparation.publisher: pins complete attempts and terminal bytes only after evaluation
commandSeparation.gate10: later re-derives package completion and never inherits a producer boolean

resourceBoundary.packetStoragePreflight: each S5 supplement registers projected bytes and minimum free space before launch
resourceBoundary.runtimeMismatch: refuse a deciding launch until a committed plan amendment and repeated preflight
resourceBoundary.capOutcome: resource refusal and maker return; never delete an attempt, silently reduce the roster, or label the result a numerical failure
